venue.name: Kanagawa Prefectural Sagamiko Community Center — Luxman Hall

events.factual_description: SADAO WATANABE QUARTET 2026 comes to Kanagawa Prefectural Sagamiko Community Center's Luxman Hall in Sagamihara on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, with doors at 6:00 PM and the performance at 6:30 PM. Sadao Watanabe's official 75th-anniversary tour page and the venue list Sadao Watanabe on alto saxophone, Akira Onozuka on piano, Daiki Mishima on bass, and Ittetsu Takemura on drums. The venue identifies the concert as part of Watanabe's 75th year in music, his first Sagamiko appearance in three years and fourth overall, and says that at Watanabe's request much of the front seating is again configured to bring listeners unusually close to the performance. Reserved seats are listed at ¥8,500 SS, ¥8,000 S, and ¥7,500 A, with a ¥4,000 student/disability discount limited to A seats. The venue currently instructs buyers to purchase or reserve at the Sagamiko Community Center counter or by phone; no dedicated online purchase URL is published on the exact event page.

en.why_it_matters: This is more than another stop on Watanabe's 75th-anniversary circuit. Sagamiko is deliberately shrinking the distance between a major Japanese jazz master and the room: at Watanabe's request, much of the front seating is configured for live-club proximity, giving the quartet's alto-piano-bass-drums conversation a setting built around breath, touch, and small changes in attack.
en.trip_verdict: If you are in Greater Tokyo/Kanto, actively make room for the run out to Sagamiko and let this be the evening; the intimate setup is the reason to choose this stop over a standard hall date. I would not build the Japan trip around it alone because the same quartet has multiple anniversary-year dates elsewhere in Japan.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta es más que otra parada del circuito por los 75 años de Watanabe. Sagamiko reduce deliberadamente la distancia entre uno de los grandes maestros vivos del jazz japonés y la sala: a petición de Watanabe, buena parte de los asientos delanteros se configura con cercanía de club, de modo que la conversación entre alto, piano, bajo y batería se escucha desde un espacio pensado para percibir respiración, tacto y pequeños cambios de ataque.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en Greater Tokyo/Kanto, sí haría espacio activamente para salir a Sagamiko y dejar que esta función arme la noche; la cercanía de la sala es la razón para escoger esta parada frente a una fecha convencional de auditorio. No construiría el viaje a Japón alrededor de ella sola porque el mismo cuarteto tiene varias fechas durante el año de aniversario.
